To give a straightforward explanation of what is alluded to here, Loglan didn't have '''y''' originally, and bare [[cmevla|cmevla]] were legal vocatives.  Some people used '''r''' as a hesitation noise, and [[pc|pc]] proposed that this was actually an invocation of the god of hesitation (see also [[ki'ai|ki'ai]]). As a result, R was introduced into the Pantheon of Loglan Gods.

==Proposals==
*'''la .ybul''' (Cf. YHWH)
**Any relation to ''Abel'' is purely coincidental...
**May be related to the DFA (Deterministic Finite Automaton). See [[Lojbanic Qabbalah|Lojbanic Qabbalah]].
* "Schwa" - a key figure in Postmodern Ufology.
